data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 were GBP 379.4m. Analysis of the claims development triangle indicates a net release on prior years of approximately GBP 22.3m (gross), representing a ~5.9% reduction on opening gross reserves. The reserve movements reflect mixed development across older underwriting years (material favourable movement in 2018 netting against some adverse development in 2017), with the report highlighting significant natural catastrophe activity in 2020 and material Covid-19 related booked losses. The release reported here is derived from the gross claims development table as no single gross prior-year movement line was provided.
raw_causal_phrases: Our booked losses relating to Covid-19 are GBP 26.3m which translates into an increase in our Combined Ratio of 25 percentage points. The majority of these losses were from event cancellation covers.

Our performance in 2020 was impacted by the frequency of natural catastrophes rather than the severity of individual events seen in previous years. Global insured losses from natural disasters in 2020 were $82bn (2019 $57bn). Natural disasters in the United States accounted for $67bn (2019 $26bn). The hurricane season in the North Atlantic was a record both in terms of total number of storms and those making landfall in the United States. The most destructive of these was Hurricane Laura which made landfall in Louisiana. Other events worth noting were Storm Derecho and a series of wildfire losses across the Western United States. In contrast, losses in Asia were lower than in previous years and experience in Europe was relatively benign (Source: Munich Re NatCat Service). The impact of these natural catastrophes worsened the Combined Ratio by 25.3 percentage points after reinsurance/retrocessional recoveries.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was not provided as a single gross figure in narrative or movement note. The prior-year movement (-22.3m gross) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative estimates diagonal comparison) and therefore marked as a calculated value (confidence 0.8). No explicit verbatim sentence describing the total gross prior year movement was found. Lob-specific reserve movements were not quantified in the report, so per-LOB directions are set to 'flat' with low confidence.
